subject.title: Create codex / claude plugins for each crawler

question: Should maintainers sponsor a uniform per-crawler AgentSkills bundle standard beyond the existing independently maintained crawler skills?
rationale: The reporter deliberately left the package contents and publishing model open, while repository policy requires crawler-specific behavior to remain downstream.

options.title: Standardize downstream bundles
options.body: Publish a lightweight checklist and have each crawler repository own its portable skill or plugin package.

options.title: Accept existing skills
options.body: Treat the currently available individual crawler skills as sufficient without creating a broader standard.

options.title: Design shared crawlkit APIs
options.body: Add shared surface only after identifying a concrete capability missing from at least two crawler packages.

recommendation.title: Standardize downstream bundles
recommendation.body: Publish a lightweight checklist and have each crawler repository own its portable skill or plugin package.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner spanning crawlkit, the crawler family, and the cross-repository product-boundary decision.
